title: Answers that help you decide if we should talk

items.question: What is a typical timeline?
items.answer: It depends on scope. A focused web or documentation piece can take a couple of weeks. A mobile app or connected system is usually several weeks to a few months. I share a written timeline after the brief.

items.question: Do you revise the work?
items.answer: Yes. Feedback is part of the build. We agree how many review rounds sit in the brief so the work stays contained.

items.question: What do you need from me to start?
items.answer: The problem, who it is for, constraints (time, devices, power, connectivity), and any existing drawings, code or brand rules.

items.question: Is VersaCarte a company team?
items.answer: No. VersaCarte is my personal practice. I am the engineer and the creator of the projects on this site.

items.question: Do you support work after delivery?
items.answer: Yes. A short support window after handoff is standard. Longer retainers can be agreed if the system needs ongoing care.

items.question: What is the best way to reach you?
items.answer: Email owner@versacarte.com or use the contact form. I reply from that address.
